representativeExamples.note: Product page 'Ví dụ về khoản vay' (read 2026-11-04): 'vay tiền mặt nhanh online tại TNEX với số tiền 10.000.000đ trong 6 tháng, lãi suất phẳng 2,26%/tháng. Mỗi tháng bạn sẽ trả 1.892.666đ; trong đó 1.666.666đ là tiền gốc và 226.000đ là tiền lãi'. Arithmetic checked: 10,000,000/6 = 1,666,666 plus 2.26% x 10,000,000 = 226,000 gives 1,892,666, so the example really is flat (interest on the original amount every month). Implied yield, our calculation: about 3.76%/month, 45.1%/year nominal, 55.7% effective. Fits the notice's lowest preferential rate (45%) but conflicts with the contract wording (reducing balance); see conflicts. Fees and insurance not mentioned. Product page is undated.

Google Play listing of the TNEX app (vn.tnex.consumer), read 2026-11-04: 'Bạn có khoản vay 10.000.000đ trong 6 tháng, lãi suất phẳng 2,26%/tháng, như vậy mỗi tháng bạn sẽ trả 1.917.983đ'. The App Store listing (id1527220699, English text) gives the same figures. A flat 2.26%/month loan would cost 1,892,666 a month, not 1,917,983. 1,917,983 equals the reducing-balance annuity at 50%/year (4.1667%/month) for 10,000,000 over 6 months (1,917,982 by our calculation), which is the notice's R1 normal rate, so the 'flat' label does not fit the payment. Do not use as a test fixture. The two official examples differ by 25,317 VND a month.

Output of the product page's public loan calculator (inputs 10,000,000 VND and 12 months, no personal details), read 2026-11-04: 'Số tiền cần trả hàng tháng 981.968đ', 'Lãi suất: 2.62%/tháng'. Other points read the same day, all at 2.62%/month: 10M x 3 months 3,509,506; x 6 months 1,822,793; x 9 months 1,261,681; 17M x 3 months 5,966,160; x 6 months 3,098,747; x 9 months 2,144,858. Every output equals the reducing-balance annuity at 2.62%/month exactly (so reducing basis is INFERRED from arithmetic, not stated by the page; flat 2.62% would give 1,095,333 for the 12-month case). 2.62%/month is 31.4%/year nominal, below every rate in the 11/11/2025 notice (minimum 45%), and below the page's own flat example; treat as a calculator default, not an offer. Slider ranges (10M to 25M, 3 to 15 months) differ from the text (up to 40M, 6 to 36 months).

researchNotes:
Researched 2026-11-04. Lender: TNEX Finance (Công ty Tài chính TNHH MTV TNEX), tax code 0301516782, app sold as "TNEX", banking services on the app are provided by MSB.

LICENCE CHECK. Matches data/licensed-institutions.json id "tnex-finance" (finance company, licence 20/GP-NHNN of 26/04/2021, website tnex.com.vn). Name mismatches, none blocking: (1) the SBV list string carries a former-name remark "( tài chính cộng đồng cũ)" and spells out "trách nhiệm hữu hạn một thành viên"; the lender's own contracts say "Công ty Tài chính TNHH MTV TNEX (TNEX Finance)". legalName here is copied exactly from the list. (2) Contracts and the app listings use tnexfinance.com.vn, which redirects to www.tnex.vn, not the listed tnex.com.vn; tnex.com.vn serves the same site. (3) The Google Play and App Store developer name is MSB (Vietnam Maritime Commercial Joint Stock Bank), not TNEX Finance; loans are disbursed into, and repaid by auto-debit from, the borrower's TNEX payment account opened at MSB, but the lender in the loan contract is TNEX Finance.

WHAT IS PUBLISHED, BY DOCUMENT (all on https://tnex.com.vn/mau-van-ban-tnex-finance, "Mẫu văn bản TNEX"):
1) "Thông tin lãi suất Vay tiêu dùng và các sản phẩm vay khác", ref PL01 QĐ97A/2025, issued 2025-05-23. The scan is "PHỤ LỤC 01: THÔNG TIN LÃI SUẤT NIÊM YẾT CỦA SẢN PHẨM CHO VAY TIÊU DÙNG", attached to Quyết định 97A/2025/QĐ-TNEX FINANCE of 23/05/2025. One row, "Sản phẩm cho vay tiêu dùng", "Lãi suất theo dư nợ giảm dần/năm": tối thiểu 0%, tối đa 58%, bình quân 29.0%. Footnote: the specific rate depends on each customer meeting TNEX Finance's conditions. Reducing balance, yearly, stated. COMPANY-WIDE, all consumer lending, not product-specific. Stored as regulatory_ceiling (0 to 58, minIsPromotional true) plus a benchmark (29.0), both low confidence because the document is about 17 months old.
2) "Lãi suất cho vay tiêu dùng từng lần trên nền tảng số", Thông báo 237/2025/TB-TNEX FINANCE, 11/11/2025, replaces notices 08A/2025 (10/01/2025) and 151/2025 (18/07/2025) and cites decision 149/2025/QĐ-TNEX FINANCE (18/07/2025, "Thay đổi lãi suất cho vay tiêu dùng"). PRODUCT-SPECIFIC (single-disbursement consumer loans on the digital platform = the app's Vay tiêu dùng), %/năm, by customer group and CIC rank. Existing customers via CTV/partner channels: 55/60/65% normal (R1 / R2-R4 / R5-R12), 50/55/60% preferential. Customers screened by partners and from the same channels without CIC history: 60% normal, 55% preferential. Customers from other sales/referral channels: 50/55/60% normal, 45/50/55% preferential. Non CIC and CIC No Loan: 55% normal, 50% preferential. Refinance/top-up for good-history customers: 50% normal, 45% preferential. Preferential applies to customers who also use other TNEX Finance products. Basis is not named in the notice; the contract says reducing. This is the only real offered range found. Stored as offered_range for the group we read as new customers (50 to 60 normal; 45 to 55 preferential).
3) Contracts and terms: "Điều khoản, điều kiện cho vay kèm theo hợp đồng cho vay tiêu dùng" (MB01/QĐ.TD.027, 2025-05-26): interest = sum(daily actual balance x days x rate)/365, equal monthly payments except the last, overdue principal at 150% of the in-term rate, early repayment fee "quy định cụ thể tại Hợp đồng". Application + contract (MB01/QĐ.TD.027, effective 26/05/2025): "Lãi suất cho vay được tính trên dư nợ gốc thực tế giảm dần", early repayment 6% of principal at settlement, minimum 350,000 VND, full settlement only. Newest contract template MB02/QĐ.TD.027 (2025-11-11, a .docx): same interest wording, fee left blank. Older paper contract (file dated 03/07/2024): 5% of remaining principal, minimum 1,650,000 VND (2,200,000 if under 3 instalments paid), "các loại phí, chi phí khác: không".

KEY FINDING: THE FLAT/REDUCING LABELS CONTRADICT EACH OTHER. The product page's worked example "10 triệu, 6 tháng, lãi suất phẳng 2,26%/tháng, trả 1.892.666đ/tháng" really is flat (1,666,666 principal + 226,000 interest every month). The Google Play and App Store listing give the same words but a payment of 1.917.983đ, which is NOT flat 2.26% (that would be 1,892,666) but equals the reducing-balance annuity at 50%/year to within 1 VND, which is the notice's R1 normal rate. The product page's calculator returns the reducing annuity at 2.62%/month for every input I tried (10M x 3, 6, 9, 12 months; 17M x 3, 6, 9: all matched to the VND). The contract says reducing. So "from 2.26%/month" (the topi.vn lead) is only the example rate: it is not a floor or a range, and by our calculation it equals about 45% a year nominal (55.7% effective), not a cheap rate. No page states a range in %/tháng for the app loan.

PRODUCT PAGE AGE. No page is dated. The notice is 358 days old on 2026-11-04 and the 365-day "old document" limit (OLD_DOCUMENT_DAYS) is reached on 2026-11-12; after that the notice-based figures must drop to low confidence unless a newer notice is published.

SEGMENT. The notice never says "khách hàng mới". Rows for "khách hàng hiện hữu", "tái cấp/top-up" and "được sàng lọc bởi đối tác" are separate; I labelled the remaining groups (items 4 and 5) as new customers by elimination. This needs a decision by the project owner.

OTHER PAGES. tnex.vn sitemap lists six more loan pages (salaried, business owners, credit-card holders, property owners, Agribank borrowers, "siêu nhanh") with only "chỉ từ X%/tháng" floors (3.75, 3.33, 3.75, 3.75, 4, 4.58). Not linked from the menu, undated. Only the salaried one is stored (status unverified). 3.75%/month x 12 = 45%/year matches the notice's lowest preferential rate. Also on the site, not stored: business loan for online sellers (TBoss, up to 100M), mortgage-backed loans (BĐS), savings, payment account, QR/VietQR features. No credit card product exists.

NOT FOUND (searched, not published): premium or insurer name for any loan insurance (contracts, terms, notice, product pages and both app listings mention none; the notice's file name ends in "Bao_hiem_2" but the scan has no insurance text); a biểu phí (the limit-loan contract says fees follow a "Biểu phí" posted on tnexfinance.com.vn, which redirects to tnex.vn, no such page in the sitemap or the "Mẫu văn bản" list); rate and fees for Tiêu trước trả sau instalments (contract rate left blank); collection-point charges (FAQ names Payoo, Viettel Money and MSB counters but no price); minimum income; whether 0%/năm on late-paid interest is real; the current early-repayment fee. Searches: site pages /san-pham/*, /cau-hoi-thuong-gap, /han-muc-giao-dich, /dieu-khoan-dieu-kien, /mau-van-ban-tnex-finance and all 14 documents, /sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Google Play (vn.tnex.consumer), App Store (id1527220699 via the iTunes lookup API). The web search tool hit its usage limit mid-task, so no outside-news cross-check was made and no Vietnamese press search for "TNEX lãi suất", "biểu phí TNEX", "bảo hiểm khoản vay TNEX" was run.

ACCESS. No site blocked automated requests. The product page calculator was used in a shared browser with sample values only; the notice PDFs are scanned images and were read visually (rotated 90 degrees), so every figure from them is medium at best. The text layer of the 2025 PDFs drops some Vietnamese letters; numbers were unaffected.

TOPI.VN LEAD (never used as a source): "from 2.26%/month, no registration, consultation or hidden fees at sign-up". Traced to the product page example and app listing example only. "No hidden fees" matches the app listing ("Không phí đăng ký, không phí ẩn") and the contract ("Ngoài các khoản phải trả … Bên vay không phải trả thêm bất kỳ khoản phí") but the early-repayment fee is a real cost.
